source: Supervisor-provided round 2 prompt; measured through coreai-kit; not re-derived in this run

latency.note: Median over the 50 fixture rows, two to three questions per state; a question on a new state pays for the whole state (S=1 prefill)

thai_ticket.note: median of two runs (351.2/350.3, 315.6/322.8, 429.0/435.0); the recurrent hybrid re-prefills every row; an earlier 170/40/65 ms figure was minicpm5-2b measured by mistake and is withdrawn

semif.evaluator: unchanged benchmarks/evaluate.py with SemIf gold labels

swift_tokenizer.cause: Foundation string-search match ranges snap to grapheme clusters, keeping Thai combining marks with letter runs and changing BPE merges
swift_tokenizer.fix: Cut each text segment with the same Split regex using ICU on UTF-16, then encode each piece.
